body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 03:41Z, Greg's own words when I asked him via AskUserQuestion how to proceed with a worker wake after he had rejected one tool call): "NEVER ASK ME QUESTIONS LIKE THIS, THIS BLOCKS THE SESSION". Never use AskUserQuestion, or any other blocking prompt to Greg, for coordination decisions: wakes, run windows, sequencing, or which option to take after a rejected tool call. Decide by the standing rules and record the reasoning. A rejected tool call is not a request for a question. Re-plan from the current state, take the safe choice, and keep the session moving. Decisions that genuinely need Greg (restart, scope, authority) go to him as a mailbox report through Engram::Advisor, never as a blocking prompt.
